scope: Post-identity L4 rescue of previously incomplete/unresolved cores. No identity recalibration, no new high structure or molecular reaction transfer.
unresolved_competition: Strictly outscore unresolved/decoy competitors, or use the separately pinned FeFe resource/independent-high-identity and exact identity-positive competitor review in module_architecture.json. Unreviewed,indeterminate or negative competitors cannot be reconciled; no function or high structure transfer.
competition: Evaluate all accepted same-family catalytic references. Defer cross-system module competition until complete assignments are available; preserve within-system resource/ownership/ambiguity guards.
subset_rule: A complete core on a strict subset of proteins does not distinguish a larger complete core. Equal or incomparable complete protein sets remain alternative hypotheses, including different mechanisms on the same set.
organization_rule: New rescues require the original reference protein partition and no partial structural member; broader natural fission/fusion still uncalibrated.
function_rule: Every newly selected core remains medium/provisional and function unassigned, regardless of similarity. Existing complete-core decisions are preserved.
development_requirements: Recover native Hthermo HoxFUYH and Tkivui HDCR exact core sets
Do not select a Sw/Tm three-subunit set for four-subunit Hnd
No Wor/Nfn hydrogenase function or identity changes
Keep all pre-identity features and calibrated decisions unchanged
Recover Ralbus three-member native core only with independently high catalytic identity and both C-terminal ligand/context sets plus mapped N-terminal scaffold ligands.
Reject legacy-only HndC as a full TmHydB scaffold even though the two C-terminal ligand sets are shared; production Hnd still needs its four-member template.

fusion_composition.scope: Provisional L4 composition only. Existing three separated Sw references may explain one complete catalytic protein plus a C-before-B fused partner on disjoint residues. Requires existing full-span literature-compatible noncanonical center pattern and all locked FeFe sequence conditions except the sole canonical-center eligibility failure. This is not calibrated high identity or function evidence; no source/query activity or cofactor occupancy transfer.
fusion_composition.competitor_rule: Every stronger unresolved competitor must have exact pinned positive catalytic identity review; any negative,decoy,indeterminate or unreviewed competitor blocks. Preserve all other graph,partial,bin,resource,FeS-extension and ambiguity guards.
